column3: Recordings from Flight Recorder can help diagnose Java application issues with garbage collections (`jdk-troubleshoot-jfr#JSTGD-GUID-3839D694-F0F7-4E43-93BE-3BF13F4D2102`).
column5: Recordings from Flight Recorder can help diagnose Java application issues with garbage collections.

column3: To investigate garbage collection issues, take a profiling flight recording without the heap statistics, because they trigger extra old collections (`jdk-troubleshoot-jfr#JSTGD-GUID-3839D694-F0F7-4E43-93BE-3BF13F4D2102`).
column5: To investigate garbage collection issues, take a profiling flight recording of your application while it is running. Do not include the heap statistics, because that triggers extra old collections.

column3: The `jfr` tool prints the `jdk.GCPhasePause` events that were recorded (`jdk-troubleshoot-jfr#JSTGD-GUID-3839D694-F0F7-4E43-93BE-3BF13F4D2102`).
column5: Use the jfr tool to print the jdk.GCPhasePause events that were recorded.

column3: From the `jdk.GCPhasePause` events, one can calculate the average sum of pauses for each GC, the maximum sum of pauses and the total pause time (`jdk-troubleshoot-jfr#JSTGD-GUID-3839D694-F0F7-4E43-93BE-3BF13F4D2102`).
column5: Using the information from the jdk.GCPhasePause events, you can calculate the average sum of pauses for each GC, the maximum sum of pauses, and the total pause time.

column3: The sum of pauses is the total amount of time that the application was paused during a GC (`jdk-troubleshoot-jfr#JSTGD-GUID-E9C795D6-3D7A-4CD8-84DD-4F7DE3200614`).
column5: The Sum of Pauses is the total amount of time that the application was paused during a GC.

column3: For GCs that do most of their work in the background, the length of the GC does not matter and what matters is how long the application actually had to stop (`jdk-troubleshoot-jfr#JSTGD-GUID-E9C795D6-3D7A-4CD8-84DD-4F7DE3200614`).
column5: In those cases, the length of the GC does not matter and what matters is how long the application actually had to stop.

column3: The main performance problems with garbage collections are usually that individual GCs take too long, or that too much time is spent in paused GCs (`jdk-troubleshoot-jfr#JSTGD-GUID-3839D694-F0F7-4E43-93BE-3BF13F4D2102`).
column5: The main performance problems with garbage collections are usually either that individual GCs take too long, or that too much time is spent in paused GCs (total GC pauses).

column3: When an individual GC takes too long, the GC strategy may need to change (`jdk-troubleshoot-jfr#JSTGD-GUID-3839D694-F0F7-4E43-93BE-3BF13F4D2102`).
column5: When an individual GC takes too long, you may need to change the GC strategy.

column5: This is indicative of the fact that application needs more memory than what you have allocated.
